tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yab rje bla mchod zhal thang 'bri tho// swasti/ bla mchod thang ka 'bri tho/ dngos gzhi dpe 'di bzhin la gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yab rje rdo rje 'chang thad zhal rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba steng khang du/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis thad zhal mnyam bzhag chos 'chad/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'ja' skor sogs med par lam 'bras bla brgyud mtshan tho zur gsal bzhin/ de'i 'og g.yas g.yon sogs la yang phur bde kyai gsang gsum tshe dpag med kun rig rnam snang dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ de'i 'og ltar la/ thub dbang dang phyogs bcu mun sel nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcu thad zhal zur zhal gang 'thad/ de 'og nye sras brgyad de 'og rang rgyal ji ltar rigs pa/ de 'og gnas brtan bcu drug gzhon nyams kho na rgya gar ba'i cha lugs la phyag mtshan so so/ de 'og gur lha brgyad/ zhal/ dur bdag dkar bdud/ de 'og rnam sras/ dzaṃ ser nag dbyu gu mched gsum/ dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub/ 'og phyogs kyi g.yas su kho bo/ g.yon du nu bo gnyis khang bzang gi nang du rab byung gis bskor nas bla mchod 'bul ba'i tshul la snying ga nas sprin las 'phros pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'phro ba bcas 'bri rgyu yin zhing / da lta yongs grags la 'dra ba'i bla mchod thang ka 'di la gzhal yas khang dang sku 'bri ba nor bas blos blangs kyi tshe shar phyogs pa rnams gtso bo la rgyab ston pa'am/ gal te mdun ston na dbu zhabs ldog dgos pa lta bu zhig 'dug par go bas dpyad pa'i gnas so// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod 'od do// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ yab rje bla mchod zhal thang 'bri tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
